title: Cadillac Escalade IQ review: Huge battery, huge range, huge SUV
gist: Ars reviews the $153,490 Cadillac Escalade IQ, a 9,046 lb electric SUV with over 200 kWh of battery, Cadillac-claimed 460-mile range and real-world ~2.1 miles/kWh. It drives well and is packed with Android Automotive tech, but has become a harder sell since the loss of the EV tax credit, and Cadillac's post-2030 plans now include combustion cars.

insights.claim: With more than 200 kWh of battery, Cadillac claims 460 miles on the EPA cycle, and the reviewer found that believable, averaging about 2.1 miles/kWh.
